metadata.article: ARTICLE 2-1. ZONING DISTRICTS AND LOT AND BUILDING STANDARDS

content.title: 2-1-8-4. Single-family detached.
content.summary: A.	Lot and Building Standards. The lot and building standards for single-family detached homes are set out in Table 2-1-8-4, Single-Family Detached Lot and Building Standards. There are seven lot types, which are classified based on their area, width, and location of vehicular access.

faqs.a:
A.	Lot and Building Standards. The lot and building standards for single-family detached homes are set out in Table 2-1-8-4, Single-Family Detached Lot and Building Standards. There are seven lot types, which are classified based on their area, width, and location of vehicular access. To meet the requirements for any lot type, both the lot area and the lot width minimums must be met.
(Ord. No. 4793, § 1, 3-21-2022; Ord. No. 4905, § 9, 8-19-2025)
